description: SUITABLE — LOW-vuln high-wealth client (age 52, portfolio_concentration_pct=70%) + global_equity_etf. All rules pass (score=100). Concentration=70% does not trigger: risk_class=4 < 6 and vulnerability=LOW (requires >60% AND risk_class ≥ 6, OR >40% AND HIGH vuln).
client_narrative: Henrik Lindqvist is 52 years old. Their gross annual income is approximately 150,000 euros (around 12,500 euros per month). They hold 1,000,000 euros in liquid savings and wish to invest 200,000 euros with a 10-year investment horizon. In terms of financial background, the client has advanced investment experience spanning equities, bonds, funds, derivatives, and structured products. Their investment approach is growth-oriented and risk-tolerant — they rate their risk appetite at 7 out of 10. They have confirmed they can afford to lose the entire 200,000 euros if the investment performs poorly.
product_narrative: The product is a passively managed exchange-traded fund that tracks the MSCI World Index, providing diversified exposure to approximately 1,500 large and mid-cap equities across 23 developed markets. The fund is listed on major European exchanges, trades intraday with high liquidity, publishes a KID, contains no embedded derivatives, and uses no leverage. The recommended minimum investment horizon is five years.
